premises.text: Fragmented travel sources and services make planning slow and leave travelers with irrelevant content and option paralysis
premises.evidence_span: Millions of sources and services have made a smooth travel planning process impossible

premises.text: Travelers act as global hosts who create and share visualizations of entire journeys that the community can access
premises.evidence_span: enabling every single traveler to be a global host for the places they visit and the activities they experience

premises.text: An AI content engine matches tags with photos and text and sorts trips by geographic relevance, quality, and personal importance to personalize feeds and generate full itineraries with transport and Airbnb matches
premises.evidence_span: an AI content engine we've built matching hundreds of thousands of tags with photos, text, and attachments

premises.text: Monetization starts with the European leisure travel segment via brand and affiliate partnerships
premises.evidence_span: We're focusing on monetizing the European subsegment first

domains.name: hosted journey sharing plus AI planner

value.text: Travelers create a whole personalized travel journey in seconds on one platform
value.evidence_span: create your whole travel journey in just a few seconds

causal_links.evidence_span: too many options leave us totally paralyzed
integrates sources and information to collect everything in one place
generating revenue through brand and affiliate partnerships

notes: Instagram/blog/Kayak/Airbnb planning pain folded as one fragmentation problem. Interest feed, magic itinerary, transport/Airbnb matching folded as AI planner cascade with UGC hosting as the content supply condition. Photo/tag counts and team credentials excluded.
